_comment: Project-level .mcp.json snippet for connecting Mac Claude Code to mcp_agent_mail running on the Spark via SSH tunnel. Place at the root of the local clone of willard-plotter-pipeline.
_setup: 1. Open SSH tunnel from Mac: ssh -fN -L 8775:127.0.0.1:8765 promaxgb10-d325
3. Pull bearer token from Spark: ssh promaxgb10-d325 'cat ~/.config/mcp_agent_mail/server_token' > ~/.config/mcp_agent_mail/spark_token
4. Copy this file to the project root as .mcp.json (replace REPLACE_ME with the token contents)
